result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but one clear data-rendering defect stands out: a delivery fee displays as '€NaN', indicating a failed numeric value. A couple of minor contrast/polish observations are also noted. Carousel edge clipping and the bottom-cut card were excluded per instructions.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in 'Fastest near you' shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price. This is a broken numeric value (Not-a-Number) leaking into the UI, signaling a data parsing/formatting failure.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery-fee computation/formatting so it always yields a valid number. Add a fallback (e.g., 'Free delivery', 'Delivery fee unavailable', or hide the line) when the value is null/undefined/NaN, and validate the source data.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray background, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text or the field background to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio for readable text.

issues.description: Secondary metadata text (e.g., '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') uses a fairly light gray that sits near the lower bound of acceptable contrast on white.
issues.suggestion: Slightly darken secondary text color to ensure consistent WCAG AA contrast across all metadata labels.
